title: NASA-UAP-D3, Gemini 7 Transcript, 1965
doc_notes: This document is a transcript of communications between the Gemini 7 crew and Houston Mission Control regarding sightings of a 'bogey' and a debris field during their 1965 flight.

incidents.summary: Astronaut Frank Borman reported a 'bogey' at ten o'clock high during the Gemini 7 mission.
incidents.quote: A BOGEY AT TEN O'CLOCK HIGH.

incidents.summary: Astronauts observed a debris field of hundreds of particles passing the spacecraft at a distance of three to four miles.
incidents.quote: WE HAVE VERY, VERY MANY A - IT LOOKS LIKE HUNDREDS OF LITTLE PARTICLES GOING BY
